description: Contract C33: decisions for every MovieSum film whose screenplay speakers do not clearly match the IMDb cast of its imdb_id (cast_check.py status low/suspect/unverifiable). Rulings by the independent evaluator (evaluator-repilot-report.md 4.1). Decisions: relabel = the text is another film's screenplay; items get target_imdb_id/target_movie_name and keep source_label. duplicate_keep_other = MovieSum files this screenplay under two ids and the other id (keep_imdb_id) matches the cast; this id is dropped so the other row is built. exclude = no film to relabel to. hold = identity unresolved; built and kept in the content set but put in hold batches outside the fan-out; release = exclude keeps its items out of the release (evaluator condition 4) until a human read is recorded in human_read ({reader, date, verdict, note}) and the decision is changed. accept_as_draft = an early draft of the same film (renamed characters); items get script_version = draft. accept = spelling/transliteration/method false positive. unverifiable_ok = IMDb lists no usable character names; speakers checked by hand.
